answer: Force every new identity through a single narrow inlet of sequential, publicly verifiable work: each step's puzzle can only be solved after the previous one, and the chain is tied to a shared clock, so work cannot be parallelized or bought in bulk. A thousand clones queue like ships at one wharf, each paying the same slow, unskippable delay, while honest agents pass once and keep their place. An attacker who tries to jump the queue - reusing a solved step or forging a timestamp - falls into the canyon between claimed and proven work, and the whole chain is discarded.
